Further parallels to the verses and the underlying narrative are found in the Āgama literature, including the *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99), the alternative *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 100), the *Ekottarikāgama* (T 125), and individual Chinese translations of the Aṅgulimāla story such as T 118 (*Fo shuo yangjuemo jing*) and T 119 (*Fo shuo yangjueji jing*) [Bingenheimer 2011].
